insights.summary: FY26 consolidated revenue was about ₹664 Cr (+62%) and PAT ₹122 Cr (+108%), ahead of the 50% revenue and 100% PAT growth guided. For FY27 management guided 30-40% revenue growth, 50-60% PAT growth and a 29-31% EBITDA margin, which the Chairman called the minimum. Growth comes from 30 more approved ANDAs to launch, the newly acquired USFDA-approved Apnar plant in Baroda (₹80-100 Cr budgeted), emerging markets (₹180 Cr) and India branded generics.

what_changed.text: FY27 guidance: revenue +30-40%, PAT +50-60%, EBITDA margin 29-31%
Acquired 75% of Apnar Pharma (USFDA, MHRA, Health Canada approved plant); shipments started in April
Amerisyn JV to sell to the US federal government and Veterans Affairs; Zoraya acquired as US front end
FY26 beat guidance: 62% revenue growth vs 50% guided, 108% PAT growth vs 100%
Fourth production line in the US pushed out after the Apnar acquisition

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: This clearly surpasses our guidance for the year.

analyst_questions.answer: Net working capital rose from 114 to 187 days because of Apnar; about 104 days excluding it.
Profit share on products sold by partners is booked as income and held as a financial asset until paid, usually 1-6 months.
Chairman: external uncertainty (shipping, US inflation); 30-40% is the minimum and may be revised after one or two quarters.
Rose from about 17% to 23.6% as US carried-forward losses ran out; about 23% going forward.

red_flags.text: Net working capital days rose from 114 to 187 in FY26 (104 excluding Apnar).
Other financial assets (profit share booked before cash) grew from ₹116 Cr to ₹172 Cr.
Operating cash flow of about ₹75 Cr against EBITDA of about ₹200 Cr.
Reported EBITDA includes other income; excluding it the margin is lower (26.5% vs about 28-28.5%).

watch_next: Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹10-20 Cr from the Apnar plant
Pace of launches among the 30 approved but unlaunched ANDAs
Working capital days falling back towards about 104
PIC/S approval for the emerging-market plant by June-July

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Generic pharmaceuticals (oral solids, liquids, injectables) for the US and other regulated markets, plus CDMO-CMO work, emerging-market exports and India branded generics
business_snapshot.customers: US pharma partners and distributors, CDMO clients, US government via the Amerisyn JV, emerging-market distributors, Indian doctors and hospitals
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: FY26: regulated markets ₹427 Cr, emerging markets ₹145 Cr, India branded generics about ₹40 Cr; own products 50-53% and CDMO-CMO 47-48%
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: ANDA approvals and launches (51 approved, 20 launched), US drug shortages, emerging-market registrations
